title: Golfing Stronger
author: Neilo
desc: I've refined this program based on recommendations from trusted sources like the Titleist Performance Institute (TPI), PGA coaches, and peer-reviewed studies on golf-specific training. All exercises are backed by expert consensus for building rotational stability, hip power, and clubhead speed while reducing injury risk (e.g., low back pain from poor rotation). Sources include TPI's power training guidelines, studies in the Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research, and PGA fitness protocols.
